new: When may Chief Gorman be used on an ordinary hand-action counteroffer, what payment avoids its return, and what happens to the returned proposer’s status, that proposer’s further counteroffers and already-paid proposal discards?

May players inspect ordinary action cards as they are discarded or while in the facedown discard pile? May they inspect the investment deck after investments have been dealt? When an ordinary hand action is stolen or given by an effect, must its identity be revealed to other players?
